hover.$description: Hover background for interactive rows (was undefined --color-bg-hover)

elevated.$description: Tertiary/elevated background (was --color-bg-tertiary: #f0f0f3, no exact primitive match)

tooltip.$description: Tooltip pill background — deliberately inverted against the light surface it floats over, not a step of it

default.$description: Default body text (alias of text.primary; was undefined --color-text-default)

muted.$description: Low-emphasis text (labels, metadata, timestamps) — follows disabled token for theme consistency

tooltip.$description: Text on the tooltip pill — pairs with color.bg.tooltip, not with the page background

solid.$description: Fill for solid accent surfaces that carry text — a step darker than accent-default so white text clears WCAG AA (5.17:1; accent-default is 3.68:1)

solidHover.$description: Hover fill for solid accent surfaces — darker than accent-solid, so contrast with accent-on-solid rises rather than falls (6.70:1)

onSolid.$description: Text on accent-solid. Never hardcode white: this flips to black in themes whose accent is light (see src/utils/color-contrast.ts)

findMatch.$description: PDF find match highlight (§272) — translucent so the canvas glyph underneath stays legible; no exact primitive match (alpha over yellow.400)

findMatchCurrent.$description: PDF find current-match highlight (§272) — more opaque than find-match to stand out; no exact primitive match (alpha over orange.500)

pdf-hl-yellow.$description: PDF text highlight — yellow (§273.3) — translucent so the canvas glyph underneath stays legible; no exact primitive match (alpha over yellow.400)

pdf-hl-green.$description: PDF text highlight — green (§273.3); no exact primitive match (alpha over green.400)

pdf-hl-blue.$description: PDF text highlight — blue (§273.3); no exact primitive match (alpha over blue.400)

pdf-hl-pink.$description: PDF text highlight — pink (§273.3); no exact primitive match (alpha over pink.500)

pdf-hl-purple.$description: PDF text highlight — purple (§273.3); no exact primitive match (alpha over purple.500)

dangerOnSolid.$description: Text on a filled danger surface. Black, because white on red-500 is 3.76:1 — under AA (#330). Derived at runtime for user-edited themes; this value covers the default and `system` themes.

dangerSolidHover.$description: Hover fill for a solid danger surface — a step LIGHTER, so contrast with the dark danger foreground rises (5.58:1 → 7.59:1) instead of falling. Direction is not a constant: it is derived from whichever foreground the fill took (#330).

warningOnSolid.$description: Text on a filled warning surface. Black, because white on yellow-500 is 2.15:1 — under even the 3:1 non-text floor (#330).

warningSolidHover.$description: Hover fill for a solid warning surface — a step LIGHTER, so contrast with the dark warning foreground rises (9.78:1 → 12.58:1) instead of falling. Direction is not a constant: it is derived from whichever foreground the fill took (#330).

successOnSolid.$description: Text on a filled success surface. Black, because white on emerald-500 is 2.54:1 — under even the 3:1 non-text floor (#330).

successSolidHover.$description: Hover fill for a solid success surface — a step LIGHTER, so contrast with the dark success foreground rises (8.28:1 → 10.92:1) instead of falling. Direction is not a constant: it is derived from whichever foreground the fill took (#330).

errorBg.$description: Error background (light tint for error containers)

tag.$description: Tag node color in graph view

crossVault.$description: Cross-vault link edge/node in graph view (matches prior #8b5cf6 fallback)

modified.$description: Git modified file (no exact primitive match)
